metadata.type: Illustrative scenario, not a validated emissions or air-quality forecast
metadata.baseline: 100 arbitrary emission units per ordinary weekday; not tonnes
metadata.grid: 4 km cell centers clipped to municipal boundary; partial edge cells treated as full cells
metadata.coordinates: Approximate local tangent plane at 30 degrees N. DataV boundary coordinate datum not independently verified; small registration offsets possible.
metadata.transport: Hourly 2D Gaussian puffs; spatially uniform forecast 10m winds; horizontal diffusivity 500 m2/s; 12h e-folding loss plus 0.05 per mm rainfall; no vertical concentrations; initial width equals source sigma. 24h spin-up uses first forecast hour persisted and first-day emissions; this is an assumption. Puff ages capped at 72h.
limitations: All source locations, weights, widths, sector splits and weekend schedules are hypothetical; no facility attribution.
No regional inflow, terrain, wind shear, stack height, boundary-layer dynamics, chemistry or observation calibration.
Footprint is a column-burden-like tracer proxy in arbitrary units/km2, not SO2 concentration in ug/m3.
Weather is sampled at one city-center location and should not be interpreted as spatial meteorology over the mountainous municipality.
15-day forecasts have increasing uncertainty; no confidence interval inferred from a single forecast.
metadata.authorityStatus: No verified, current, municipality-wide SO2 mass inventory or facility-level activity forecast was obtained. Numerical emissions remain hypothetical; the existing simulation is not an authoritative emissions forecast.
